blocks.text: **get** (get — got — got) — so'zlashuvda eng ko'p ishlatiladigan fe'llardan biri. O'zbekchada unga bitta so'z mos kelmaydi: ma'nosi undan **keyingi so'zga** qarab o'zgaradi — «olmoq», «sotib olmoq», «bo'lib qolmoq», «yetib bormoq», «chiqmoq / tushmoq». Rasmiy matnda get o'rniga aniqroq fe'llar ishlatiladi (receive, buy, become, arrive), lekin kundalik nutqda get ancha tabiiy eshitiladi.

rows: get in / on / out of / off

blocks.text: 1. get + ot: olmoq, sotib olmoq, topmoq

**get** + ot ko'pincha «qo'lga kiritmoq» ma'nosida: get a letter / a message / a present — **olmoq** (kimdir yubordi); get a ticket / some bread — **sotib olmoq**; get a job — **ishga kirmoq**, **ish topmoq**; get a taxi — **taksi tutmoq**; get somebody something — **olib kelmoq**: I'll **get** you a glass of water. Aniq ma'no kontekstdan tushuniladi.

items.text: I **got** an email from my teacher.
My brother **got** a job in Dubai.

blocks.text: **get** + sifat — holatning **o'zgarishini** bildiradi: get tired — charchab qolmoq, get hungry — qorni ochmoq, get dark — qorong'i tushmoq, get better — yaxshilanmoq. O'zbekchada bunga ko'pincha «-ib qolmoq», «-lashmoq» yoki alohida fe'l mos keladi. Taqqoslang: I'm **tired** — charchaganman (holat); I'm **getting tired** — charchayapman (holat o'zgaryapti). O'zgarish hozir sodir bo'layotgan bo'lsa — Present Continuous: It**'s getting** cold.

items.text: Don't **get angry** — it was a joke!

blocks.text: get married, get dressed, get lost

Ba'zi iboralarni tayyor holda yodlang: get **married** — turmush qurmoq / uylanmoq, get **divorced** — ajrashmoq, get **dressed** — kiyinmoq, get **changed** — kiyim almashtirmoq, get **lost** — adashib qolmoq, get **ready** — tayyorlanmoq. Taqqoslang: They **got married** in 2020 (voqea — to'y bo'ldi) va They**'re married** (holat — ular er-xotin).

items.text: My cousin **is getting married** next month.

blocks.text: 3. get to, get home: yetib bormoq

**get to** + joy — «yetib bormoq / kelmoq» (arrive): get **to** work, get **to** the station, get **to** London. **home**, **there**, **here** oldidan to yo'q (55-darsdagi go home kabi): get **home**, get **there**. Yo'l qancha vaqt olishini so'rash — 48-dars: How long does it take to **get to** the airport?

items.text: What time did you **get home** last night?
items.translation: Kecha kechqurun uyga soat nechada **yetib keldingiz**?

items.text: How do I **get to** the city centre?

blocks.text: 4. get in / out of, get on / off

Transportga chiqish va tushish: **kichik** transport (car, taxi) — **get in** / **get out of**; **katta** transport (bus, train, plane) va **velosiped, mototsikl, ot** — **get on** / **get off**. Mantig'i: mashinaning «ichiga kiramiz» (in), avtobus va poyezdga esa go'yo «ustiga chiqamiz» (on). O'zbekchada: mashinaga o'tirmoq, avtobusga chiqmoq, poyezddan tushmoq.

items.text: We **got off** the bus near the bazaar.

blocks.text: **get up** — «o'rnidan turmoq»: I **get up** at seven — «Soat yettida turaman». **get back** — «qaytmoq»: When did you **get back** from Samarkand? — «Samarqanddan qachon qaytdingiz?» Bular — frazali fe'llar, ular haqida batafsil — 114–115-darslarda.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «get to home» → **get home**; «I got married with Aziz.» → **I got married to Aziz.** yoki **I married Aziz.**; «get in the bus» → **get on the bus**; «get off the car» → **get out of the car**; «arrive to London» → **arrive in London** yoki **get to London**; «I became hungry.» — xato emas, lekin so'zlashuvda **I got hungry** tabiiyroq.

get ning ma'nosini aniqlash uchun undan keyingi so'zga qarang: **ot** → olmoq; **sifat** → bo'lib qolmoq; **to / home** → yetib bormoq; **in / on / off / out** → chiqmoq yoki tushmoq; **up** → turmoq. get ni faqat «olmoq» deb yodlab olmang — uning ma'nolari ko'p.

rows: get a letter, get a ticket, get a job
get tired, get dark, get better

examples.title: **get** + noun: receive, buy, find
examples.description: get + ot — «olmoq»: xat yoki xabar olmoq (receive), sotib olmoq (buy), ish topmoq (find a job), olib kelmoq. Aniq ma'noni kontekst aytib beradi.

sentences.text: Did you **get** my message? — Yes, thanks.
I **got** a lovely present from my sister.
Where can I **get** a ticket for the train?
Aziz **got** a job at a bank in Tashkent.
Could you **get** some bread on your way home?
We **got** a taxi from the airport to the hotel.
How much do teachers **get** in your country?
Emma **gets** about fifty emails a day at work.
sentences.translation: Emma ishda kuniga ellikka yaqin elektron xat **oladi**.

sentences.text: I'll **get** you a glass of water.
When James was in hospital, he **got** a lot of cards from his friends.
sentences.translation: Jeyms shifoxonada yotganida do'stlaridan ko'plab otkritkalar **oldi**.

examples.title: **get** + adjective: **get** tired, **get** hungry
examples.description: get + sifat — holatning o'zgarishi, «bo'lib qolmoq»: get tired — charchab qolmoq, get hungry — qorni ochmoq, get angry — jahli chiqmoq. become ham mumkin, lekin so'zlashuvda get ko'proq ishlatiladi.

sentences.text: I always **get tired** after a long flight.
Put on your coat or you'll **get cold**.
The children **got hungry** on the way to Samarkand.
My father **gets angry** when people drive too fast.
sentences.translation: Odamlar juda tez mashina haydasa, dadamning **jahli chiqadi**.

sentences.text: In winter it **gets dark** very early.
Don't worry — your English will **get better** with practice.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang — mashq qilsangiz, ingliz tilingiz **yaxshilanadi**.

sentences.text: We **got wet** because we didn't have an umbrella.
Sarah **got bored** at the party and left early.
sentences.translation: Sara ziyofatda **zerikib qoldi** va erta ketdi.

sentences.text: After the operation Grandma's health **got worse**, so she stayed in hospital.
sentences.translation: Operatsiyadan keyin buvimning ahvoli **yomonlashdi**, shuning uchun u shifoxonada qoldi.

sentences.text: Bekzod **got nervous** before his first job interview in London.
sentences.translation: Londondagi birinchi ish suhbati oldidan Bekzod **hayajonlanib qoldi**.

examples.title: **getting** + adjective: things are changing
examples.description: is getting + sifat — o'zgarish hozir sodir bo'lyapti: It's getting dark — «qorong'i tushyapti», prices are getting higher — «narxlar oshyapti».

sentences.text: It**'s getting dark** — turn on the lights, please.
Drink your tea — it**'s getting cold**.
My grandparents **are getting old**, and they need more help.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim **qarib qolishyapti**, ularga ko'proq yordam kerak.

sentences.text: The weather **is getting warmer** every day.
Are you **getting hungry**? Dinner will be ready soon.
sentences.translation: **Qorningiz ochyaptimi**? Kechki ovqat tez orada tayyor bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Prices in the shops **are getting higher** and higher.
Tashkent **is getting bigger**: there are new buildings everywhere.
Dilnoza's English **is getting better** because she reads every day.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning ingliz tili **yaxshilanyapti**, chunki u har kuni kitob o'qiydi.

sentences.text: When we arrived, it **was getting late**, so we went straight to bed.
sentences.translation: Biz yetib kelganimizda **kech kirib qolgan edi**, shuning uchun to'g'ri uxlashga yotdik.

sentences.text: I**'m getting tired** of this noise — when will they finish the work?
sentences.translation: Bu shovqindan **charchab ketyapman** — ular ishni qachon tugatishadi?

examples.title: **get married**, **get dressed**, **get lost**, **get ready**
examples.description: Tayyor iboralar: get married — turmush qurmoq / uylanmoq, get dressed — kiyinmoq, get lost — adashib qolmoq, get ready — tayyorlanmoq, get divorced — ajrashmoq, get changed — kiyim almashtirmoq.

sentences.text: Madina and Bekzod **got married** last summer.
sentences.translation: Madina va Bekzod o'tgan yozda **turmush qurishdi**.

sentences.text: Hurry up and **get dressed** — we're late!
We **got lost** in the old streets of Bukhara.
How long does it take you to **get ready** in the morning?
When **are** Tom and Sarah **getting married**? — In June.
sentences.translation: Tom va Sara qachon **turmush qurishadi**? — Iyunda.

sentences.text: My cousin **got divorced** two years ago.
Take a map so you don't **get lost**.
The children **are getting ready** for school.
I **got dressed** quickly because the taxi was waiting outside.
sentences.translation: Taksi tashqarida kutib turgani uchun tez **kiyindim**.

sentences.text: Emma **got changed** after work and went straight to the gym.
sentences.translation: Emma ishdan keyin **kiyimini almashtirdi** va to'g'ri sport zaliga ketdi.

examples.title: **get to**, **get home**: arriving
examples.description: get to + joy — yetib bormoq (arrive): get to work, get to the station. home, there, here oldidan to qo'yilmaydi: get home — uyga yetib kelmoq.

sentences.text: What time do you usually **get to work**?
We **got home** very late last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun uyga juda kech **yetib keldik**.

sentences.text: How do I **get to the station** from here?
Call me when you **get there**.
It takes me forty minutes to **get to university** by bus.
Aziz **got to the airport** just in time for his flight.
sentences.translation: Aziz parvozga zo'rg'a ulgurib **aeroportga yetib keldi**.

sentences.text: When we **got to the cinema**, there were no tickets left.
Text me as soon as you **get home**, OK?
sentences.translation: **Uyga yetib borishing** bilan menga yozib qo'y, xo'pmi?

sentences.text: The train **gets to Samarkand** at half past ten.
sentences.translation: Poyezd Samarqandga soat o'n yarimda **yetib boradi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **didn't get to the meeting** on time because of the traffic.
sentences.translation: Tirbandlik tufayli Sara yig'ilishga o'z vaqtida **yetib bormadi**.

examples.title: **get in** / **out of** a car, **get on** / **off** a bus
examples.description: Transportga chiqish va tushish: kichik transport (car, taxi) — get in / get out of; katta transport (bus, train, plane) va velosiped — get on / get off.

sentences.text: **Get in** the car — it's starting to rain!
We **got on** the bus outside the hotel.
Which stop do I **get off** at for the museum?
Grandma needs help to **get out of** the car.
Dilnoza **got off** the train at the wrong station.
Please let people **get off** the train before you **get on**.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, poyezdga **chiqishdan** oldin odamlarning **tushishiga** imkon bering.

sentences.text: When the taxi stopped, James **got out** and paid the driver.
sentences.translation: Taksi to'xtaganda Jeyms **tushdi** va haydovchiga pul to'ladi.

sentences.text: Is this the right bus? Should we **get on** or wait for the next one?
sentences.translation: Bu to'g'ri avtobusmi? **Chiqaylikmi** yoki keyingisini kutaylikmi?

sentences.text: Bekzod **got on** his bike and rode to the shop.
The plane landed, but we couldn't **get off** for half an hour.
sentences.translation: Samolyot qo'ndi, lekin yarim soat davomida **tusha olmadik**.

examples.title: Questions and answers with **get**
examples.description: get bilan savol va qisqa javoblar, ma'nolar aralash: get up (turmoq), get here (kelmoq), get the job (ishga kirmoq), get back (qaytmoq).

sentences.text: What time do you **get up** on weekdays? — At half past six.
sentences.translation: Ish kunlari soat nechada **turasiz**? — Olti yarimda.

sentences.text: How **did** you **get** here? — By taxi.
**Did** Madina **get** the job? — Yes, she starts on Monday.
sentences.translation: Madina o'sha **ishga kirdimi**? — Ha, dushanbadan boshlaydi.

sentences.text: Is it **getting** colder outside? — Yes, take a jacket.
When **did** you **get back** from Moscow? — Last night.
Where **did** you **get** that lovely scarf? — At the market in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Bu chiroyli sharfni qayerdan **oldingiz**? — Samarqanddagi bozordan.

sentences.text: **Do** you **get** nervous before exams? — Not any more.
Who **got up** first this morning? — Dad did, as always.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab kim birinchi **turdi**? — Dadam, har doimgidek.

sentences.text: Why **did** you **get off** the bus so early? — I wanted to walk a bit.
sentences.translation: Nega avtobusdan buncha erta **tushdingiz**? — Biroz piyoda yurmoqchi edim.

sentences.text: How long does it take to **get to** Oxford from London? — About an hour by train.
sentences.translation: Londondan Oksfordga **yetib borish** qancha vaqt oladi? — Poyezdda bir soatcha.

examples.title: Dialogue: a difficult morning
examples.description: Suhbatda get ning turli ma'nolari: get up, get a call, get angry, get to, get a taxi, get lost, get hungry, get home.

sentences.text: — You look tired, Aziz. What time **did** you **get up**?
— At five! I **got** a call from my boss at half past four.
sentences.translation: — Beshda! Soat to'rt yarimda boshlig'imdan **qo'ng'iroq keldi**.

sentences.text: — Oh no! **Did** you **get angry** with him?
— No, he just needed me to **get to** the office early.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, unga shunchaki ofisga erta **yetib borishim** kerak edi.

sentences.text: — And how **did** you **get** there so early? There are no buses.
sentences.translation: — U yerga shuncha erta qanday **yetib bording**? Avtobus yo'q-ku.

sentences.text: — I **got** a taxi, but the driver **got lost**!
— Really? So **did** you **get** there late?
— Ten minutes late. And I **got** really **hungry** because I didn't have breakfast.
sentences.translation: — O'n daqiqaga kechikdim. Nonushta qilmaganim uchun **qornim** juda **ochib ketdi**.

sentences.text: — Poor you! Let me **get** you a coffee and a sandwich.
sentences.translation: — Bechora! Senga qahva va sendvich **olib kelay**.

sentences.text: — Thanks! I hope I **get home** early tonight.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat! Bugun uyga erta **yetib borsam** edi.
